name: rare
label: rare_chars
note: rare_chars: two tiers in one pass. Rules without "tier" form the strict tier (per-corpus FPR target ~0.1%); "tier": "monitor" rules are added for the monitoring tier (~0.5%). Fixed rules + one learned-score (gb) rule per tier. gb scores gated tokens only (fs < 0.05 or bad_utf8); look-ahead by one token so alerts fire on the token after the trigger. lp1/lpc are log10 of top-1 / chosen probability; gap = lp1 - lpc. Uses ref=cats (no frequency reference tables).
